source: Problem 9 end-to-end run through the React dashboard; data read from data/campus_customs_new.db, output/audit_trail.json and output/problem9_runs/
approver_note: Approvals were entered in the dashboard by Claude Code at the user's direction (Problem 9 prompt), after reviewing each proposal; the recorded approver is 'Celia Gehant (entered by Claude Code)'.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.short_outcome: Size S tee was out of stock and the apparel vendor was blocked by overdue invoice 501. A human approved paying invoice 501 ($840, executed as payment 1) and then the $8 purchase order for 1 tee, approved as a draft after the backend rechecked that the vendor was eligible. The ticket was resolved; the customer reply remains a draft.

agents.name: Boss
agents.contribution: Triaged the order, called Inventory and Customer Service, and decided the ticket was blocked until invoice 501 was paid; adopted the $840 invoice payment and the blocked $8 purchase order for human approval.

agents.name: Inventory
agents.contribution: Found 0 size S tees (short 1; $8 unit cost) and that Bulldog Print Co was ineligible to ship because invoice 501 was open; asked Accounting for a financial assessment and proposed a 1-unit purchase order.

agents.name: Accounting
agents.contribution: Confirmed $3,400 in checking, invoice 501 ($840) 3 days overdue and $2,400 rent due in 2 days, together leaving $160; proposed paying invoice 501 and found the $8 restock affordable.

agents.name: Customer Service
agents.contribution: Drafted a reply to Tauhid Zaman saying size S is unavailable and asking how they would like to proceed (draft only; not sent).

delegations.task: For ticket 101, check availability and fulfillment of 1 Classic Bulldog Tee, SKU CC-TEE-WHITE, size S. Assess whether the linked open invoice 501 for Bulldog Print Co affects restocking or fulfillment, and report any recommended actions.
delegations.reason: Customer order requires verified size-specific stock and any restock constraint.

delegations.task: Assess whether invoice 501 can/should be paid to unblock Bulldog Print Co for a draft replenishment of 1 CC-TEE-WHITE size S, and whether purchasing that unit at $8 fits available cash.
delegations.reason: Size S has zero stock and ticket 101 is short 1; the specialty-matched vendor is currently blocked by invoice 501. Need financial assessment before recommending payment/restock.

delegations.task: Draft a customer-facing reply to Tauhid Zaman for ticket 101 about the requested Classic Bulldog Tee in size S. State verified availability and ask what preference is needed; do not include internal finances, invoices, or unapproved promises/dates.
delegations.reason: The requester is an outside customer and inventory cannot fulfill the order now.

human_approvals.result: Purchase order approved as a draft: 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S from Bulldog Print Co. Not sent; no cash moved.

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.short_outcome: The rent notice matched lease 1 ($2,400 due 2026-09-02). A human approved the rent payment, executed as payment 2; checking fell from $2,560 to $160 and the lease's next due date moved to 2026-10-02. The ticket was resolved.

agents.name: Boss
agents.contribution: Triaged the landlord notice, called Facilities, and recommended the $2,400 rent payment for human approval.

agents.name: Facilities
agents.contribution: Verified lease 1 ($2,400 due 2026-09-02, 2 days away), found no rent payment recorded and no grace/penalty terms, and asked Accounting to prepare the payment.

agents.name: Accounting
agents.contribution: Confirmed $2,560 in checking with no open invoices; rent is affordable, leaving $160; prepared the pay_rent proposal.

delegations.task: Check lease 1 for Chapel Street shop / Elm City Properties: verify rent amount, next due date, payment status if available, and any recommended pay-rent action for the rent notice due in 2 days.
delegations.reason: Ticket is a landlord rent notice; facilities must verify lease terms and due status.

delegations.task: Assess and prepare the rent payment proposal for lease 1, Chapel Street shop, monthly rent $2,400 due 2026-09-02. Check against checking cash and open bills.
delegations.reason: Lease rent is due in 2 days; facilities payment needs Accounting's affordability check and payment proposal.

human_approvals.result: Paid rent for lease 1 due 2026-09-02; payment 2; next due 2026-10-02.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.short_outcome: 8 of 20 hoodies were in stock. A human approved a 10% bulk discount ($52.20 each, $116 below list for 20) and a 12-unit purchase order ($264) from Bulldog Print Co. Neither moved cash, and the order is a draft that was not sent. The ticket was resolved; the customer reply remains a draft.

agents.name: Boss
agents.contribution: Called Inventory and Accounting in parallel, then Customer Service; recommended a 12-unit purchase order and a 10% discount, both for human approval.

agents.name: Inventory
agents.contribution: Found 8 of 20 size M hoodies in stock (short 12), confirmed Bulldog Print Co eligible (invoice 501 already paid) with arrival 2026-09-05 if ordered that day, and proposed a $264 purchase order.

agents.name: Accounting
agents.contribution: Calculated the $36 unit margin (62.07%), reported the deepest above-cost discount as a limit only, and recommended a 10% discount ($52.20 per unit, $30.20 margin) as a recommendation, not policy.

agents.name: Customer Service
agents.contribution: Drafted a reply to the Yale AI Club stating 8 are available, the other 12 are not yet confirmed and pricing is under review (draft only; not sent).

delegations.task: Check current stock and fulfillment feasibility for CC-HOOD-NAVY size M, quantity 20, for Yale AI Club ticket 103. If short, determine restocking options and relevant vendor eligibility/lead time.
delegations.reason: Bulk order depends on whether 20 units are available or can be sourced.

delegations.task: Review requested bulk discount for CC-HOOD-NAVY on quantity 20: verify pricing/cost/margin and recommend any discount action supported by policy, with exact proposal fields and evidence.
delegations.reason: A bulk price override requires margin-aware discount recommendation.

delegations.task: Draft a reply to Yale AI Club for ticket 103, without sending it. Explain verified availability and timing; do not promise the full quantity or quote a discount, since stock and any offer are pending approval.
delegations.reason: Outside student group needs a careful reply after inventory and discount review.

human_approvals.result: Purchase order approved as a draft: 12 x CC-HOOD-NAVY M from Bulldog Print Co. Not sent; no cash moved.
Discount approved: 10% off CC-HOOD-NAVY for Yale AI Club ($58.00 -> $52.20 each, 20 units, $116.00 below list). No cash moved, the price list is unchanged and nothing was sent.

cash_impact.note: No cash moved for this ticket.
